scope: Standard interpretable baseline, not a new neural research mechanism. Objective/centroid mathematics independently implemented with fixed project budgets; no author trainer, split, tuned settings or checkpoint copied.

reference.reuse: Installed reference imports only for synthetic loss/gradient and Euclidean centroid checks; no source copied/vendored and no upstream real-data optimizer used.
reference.difference: Project fixed64/128 full-batch GD steps are not scikit-learn's converged solver or its defaults. Fixed centroid score temperature is a declared reference, not calibrated probability.

components: C6 ReleasedBank original NPY reader through the C7 object
C7 coarse ontology and restored17-tile snapshot
C7_reuse.raw_branch: C8 obtains exact raw values with the same admitted bank reader; the old normalized output is not inverted or treated as raw. Internally computed unused normalization is disclosed and raw-feature independence is checked.
C7_reuse.no_parallel_reader: No new MAT/NPY decoder or dataset registration introduced.

planned_tests: finite difference and maintained-reference objective/gradient agreement
centroid prediction/mean equivalence on synthetic data
band permutation and samplewise affine invariance/constant-spectrum handling
independent scalar-loop real gradient replay plus independent feature/metric/statistic reconstruction
dataset_metadata: Reuse C7. No new source/version/license search or payload download. Its data rights, ontology inference and exposed-development limits remain in force.
